scientific_integrity: The argument uses explicit third-vertex extension counts and their algebraic signs; finite checks corroborate but do not prove the infinite statement. Priority remains qualified by possible general coherent-configuration implications. Original self-review is not independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite thick partial geometries; noncounting first-order logic with unary point/line sorts, incidence, named collinearity and named line concurrence. Incidence-only reduct, thin cases, counting quantifiers, and more than three variable symbols are outside scope. Nine classes are witnessed with 50-element-or-smaller structures; no optimal size bound is claimed.
title: Nine unrestricted three-variable theories of thick partial geometries with named collinearity
